caption: Average performance of different models on the November 2024 AMC-10 and AMC-12 tests. This is the average score (with maximum score 150) over the four tests on 100 runs with temperature t=0.5. We chose t = 0.5 to follow simple-evals <cit.>. Error bars are 2 of the estimate. On competition math, scores well above its weight-class even compared to non–open-weight models.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of several language models on AMC 10/12 tests conducted in November 2024. The horizontal axis displays the names of the models, listed in alphabetical order: Llama-3 70b Instruct, Claude-3 Sonnet, GPT 4, GPT 4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct, Qwen 72b-Instruct, Gemini 1.5 Flash, Gemini Pro 1.5, Phi-4, and Llama-3. The vertical axis, labeled “Average score (temperature = 0.5),” uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 95, with tick labels at increments of 10.  Each model's average score is represented by a bar accompanied by an error bar, with the error bar indicating an uncertainty of approximately 2 units. The bars are colored in alternating shades of blue and light blue, with the first group of models (Llama-3.3, Claude-3.5, Qwen 2.5, and GPT 4o-mini) shown in dark blue and the remaining models in light blue.  The shortest bar, representing Llama-3 70b Instruct, shows a value of approximately 66.4, while the tallest bar, representing Phi-4, indicates a value of approximately 91.8. The error bars for each bar appear to be largely consistent in length.
